Ian Ballon is an American Internet and intellectual property litigator, [ 1 ] author of books on Internet law [ 2 ] and executive director of Stanford University Law School 's Center for E-Commerce. [ 3 ] He is the author of the 4-volume legal treatise , E-Commerce and Internet Law: Treatise with Forms 2d edition, the leading legal reference book on Internet law, which was first published in 2000. [ 4 ] A second edition was published in 2008 and is updated annually. [ 5 ] He is also an intellectual property litigator with Greenberg Traurig LLP, a firm of approximately 1800 lawyers. [ 6 ]
